summary: Backend regression 15/15 PASSED. Frontend mobile flows (390x844) verified end-to-end after guest login + intro-skip: Home (prayer card, check-in -> share sheet), bottom tabs (tab-focus label='Blocker'), Qibla (bearing 295.2° for Jakarta, compass + simulation slider), Blocker (enable switch, reminder chips, app list, ambient toggles, pro chip, demo modal with demo-hold-button/demo-snooze-button), Al-Qur'an (search, filters, surah reader with translation switch, verse bookmark, back), Progres (streak, calendar, achievements, ShareComposer with 4 templates/3 tints/4 captions/switches/confirm/close), Settings (Pro screen, pro-feature-0 -> Hajj guide with hajj-section-0, dark theme switch, logout). Two low-severity React Native web warnings persist: deprecated shadow* style props and deprecated props.pointerEvents. transformOrigin warning from previous iteration is no longer present.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Recurs from RN web renderer. Search shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius across /app/frontend/src (styles) and migrate to boxShadow for web-compatible styling.
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Grep for pointerEvents={...} on View/Animated.View and move to style.pointerEvents.

action_items: Optional cleanup: migrate deprecated shadow* style props to boxShadow and move pointerEvents into style to silence RN web warnings.

Consider persisting settings.onboarded=true after intro-finish so that returning users are not redirected back to Intro after guest login (currently intro-skip is needed even when azam-intro-done is set in localStorage; not blocking, both bypass paths work).
Verify long-press dismissal of blocker demo overlay on a real touch device (web pointer automation cannot reliably fire GestureHandler long-press).
critical_code_review_comments: Backend consistently excludes MongoDB _id via projection ({_id:0}) and via response_model — verified via test_mongodb_object_id_not_serialized_in_response.
All backend endpoints validate inputs via Pydantic Field constraints (lat/lng range, month regex, alarm_time pattern, blocked_prayers Literal) and return meaningful Indonesian error messages.
Session TTL correctly enforced with Mongo TTL index (expireAfterSeconds=0 on sessions.expires_at); invalid token returns 401.
Env-driven config: backend uses MONGO_URL/DB_NAME, frontend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL — no hardcoded URLs found.
seed_data_creation: Only ephemeral guest users via POST /api/auth/guest during tests; no persistent seed data written.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend URL: https://quranic-focus-2.preview.emergentagent.com. To reach Home quickly: localStorage.setItem('azam-intro-done','1'); reload; click guest-login-button; if intro re-appears, click intro-skip-button. Blocker prayer chip testIDs are lowercase (blocker-prayer-subuh/zuhur/asar/magrib/isya) not capitalized. All 30+ testIDs from the review request were located and interactive.
